snippet.title: FORKLIFT FLOWERPOT - First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
Add to your Steam Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073330/FORKLIFT_FLOWERPOT/

As an independent developer making this game by myself, wishlists help me tremendously. I do not have a publisher who can help push me past the gates of Steam's algorithm. Thanks for your help!

Here's a first look on the game I'm currently developing: FORKLIFT FLOWERPOT. At the time of this trailer's creation, I've spent 280 hours working on creating and marketing this game. Tracking my work hours has allowed me to stay focused and motivated as well as celebrate small wins on a regular basis.


About the game: 
You are the FORKLIFT FLOWERPOT: a modern marvel of engineering perfection.

Drive, Sail, and Fork your way around a fantastic archipelago to document local alien life. Change the seasons at your whim to solve puzzles and study plants across different climates. Meet wacky characters, participate in local sporting events, and delve deep into the mysteries of a strange land.
